Jungheinrich Business Services Romania S.R.L. Join Jungheinrich in a working environment where you can make a big difference! With your knowledge and drive, as a team player you will make an important contribution to ensure that we as a company continue to be among the global leaders in our industry. Working side by side with colleagues who enjoy bold ideas and in a family environment that offers you every opportunity to reconcile your professional and private goals.
Requirements for success:
University degree with major in finance / accounting
3 – 5 years of professional GL experience and 2 - 4 years subject-specific experience (design and optimization of accounting process in GL area)
Responsibility within month end closing activities is a plus
End-to-end process knowledge in accounting, especially general ledger
Participation in projects for process standardization, automation and harmonisation, including being part of a transition from R3 to S4 is a plus
Moderate knowledge in fixed assets is a plus
Very good knowledge in SAP R3 or S4, especially module SAP FI
Experience operating in global and matrixed organization
Language: Fluent English, German is a plus
Very good knowledge of MS Office, SharePoint and JIRA
Good knowledge in IFRS, Knowledge of German HGB and EStG is a plus
Results-oriented working
Conceptual strength
Organizational skills
Communication skills
 Therefore, a successful candidate would be responsible for:
Design and optimization of general ledger processes in SAP S/4HANA within the group’s digitalization program
Solution development and realisation for process improvements
Takeover of a global and cross-functional Business-Process-Lead function for general ledger processes, as well as support of data owners for developing corresponding data objects
Recording of requirements regarding a global process template and local process variants
Support of global, regional and local process owner with content and process knowledge
Design, modelling and responsibility for fulfilment of global GL processes
Creation of user stories and test concepts including testcases and execution of user test within the new SAP S/4HANA system
Responsibility and enforcement of account governance in S/4HANA as well as in the current ERP System (SAP R3)
Provide support to the global process owner for fixed asset accounting
 Jungheinrich was founded in 1953 in Hamburg by Dr. Friedrich Jungheinrich as a family business. Today, we are one of the world's leading intralogistics companies with a unique product portfolio: from conventional industrial trucks to fully automated solutions intralogistics companies. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Jungheinrich is represented by its own direct sales companies in 41 countries and by partner companies in around 80 other countries around the world, and employs more than 19,000 people internationally.
We look forward to receiving your online application.
